name: yaps
description: Use local Yaps Memory, transcription, meeting transcripts, subtitles, translation, and media conversion from Claude.
long_description: Work with Yaps from Claude Desktop without sending private notes or media through a hosted connector. Search and safely update your local Markdown Memory, transcribe audio and video, create speaker-labelled meeting transcripts, generate SRT subtitles, translate text and files locally, and extract audio from video. Yaps refuses to replace existing output files, keeps Memory read-only until you enable writes in Agent Access, and processes supported workflows on your computer. The Yaps desktop app is required; processing features require an active free trial or Yaps Pro.
